title: Mother and Child in Park Garden, 1954 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white outdoor snapshot taken on July 18, 1954, featuring 31-year-old Connie and 2-year-old Cary standing hand-in-hand next to a manicured flower bed. In the background, a large pavilion-style building and other visitors enjoy a summer day at a public park, capturing mid-century American family leisure culture.
